name: chronological-etf-history-audit-2026-10-20
hypothesis: Audit whether earlier chronological market history can broaden training regimes before another learner experiment; no selection of symbols or windows from future losses.
reason_for_start: Fixed first full calendar year after the youngest baseline ETF listing; include every available session through 2009 without outcome-based filtering.
corrections: None; invalid source rows stop acceptance, never fabricate a price.
acquisition: Existing immutable accumulation, full-range symbol chunks, at most 3 transient attempts per chunk, 30-second request timeout, no feed fallback.
acceptance: All four declared symbols and every XNYS session, with no extra sessions
Canonical UTC chronology, finite prices/actions and valid OHLC geometry
Every normalized OHLCV and dividend agrees with retained raw source
Raw stock splits are retained and never applied twice to split-adjusted prices
No negative cash dividends, invalid split factors, or unsupported nonzero capital-gain distributions
regime_reporting: Past-only 63-session and 252-session close returns, and joint trailing declines; report by symbol/year, never select future losing symbols.
follow_up: If source-consistent and coverage-complete, separately preregister original training versus equal-mass recent-ETF versus old-ETF augmentation; match ETF sampling mass, observations, transitions, costs and validation. Audit cross-snapshot price-unit continuity before merging. Keep existing stock/ETF, selected/final, drawdown and multi-seed gates, plus prospective confirmation. ETF evidence does not solve stock delisting coverage.
